observations.finding: Blanket-load reversal gives Buddy an early failed tactic. The isolated Perhaps she meant another Buddy line holds his sock freeze; the picture prolongs that caught-in-the-act pause before Blue sock. Mouth. You. The eye-shift in response to six inches is a clean short payoff without explanatory padding.

Neet treats laundry as a territory and inspection problem, including a sincerely puzzled red-shirt complaint. Buddy independently protects comfort, steals socks, replaces Neet on towels, chooses to retain that stack and obstructs the chase. Heather gives concrete dry commands and adapts by moving laundry directly into the basket; Sagar provides amused restraint and physical interception.

The day advances clearly from collection to clean load, dryer, folding, final pillowcase delivery, evening and night. Buddy taking the position vacated when Sagar lifts Neet makes the folding reversal causal. The final blue sock and guest blanket reunite both wants; Neet making room supplies affection before the guest-room last-line joke. Unillustrated chase and ending read continuously and are not crowded by another image.

Buddy is paused with the connected blue socks and Heather points, while Neet is belly-down on couch laundry. The source explicitly rolls Neet back onto his belly before this. Placement is after Buddy froze and before the bolt, with no premature running or relinquished object.

Neet sits at closed glass containing red fabric; Buddy lies settled on tile beside him. This matches the continued inspection and refusal to move after Heather steps over him. The image does not pretend Heather is opening the spinning appliance.

Sagar holds Neet with visible support while Buddy sits on the white towels; Heather is at left holding another stack. Placement precedes her transfer into the basket, preserving that stack state. Buddy occupation and Neet glancing toward it make the succession joke clear at reading size.

Sock art supplies the public exposure of a failed stealth operation, dryer art a quieter dog-level contrast of vigilant work and comfort, and folding art the humans caught between two opportunists. Changing location, height, posture and scale prevents repeated reaction portraits.

All prose, headings and pictures render legibly with no missing image, overlap or clipped text. The narrative ends before provenance. The footer retains its pre-review statement that pictures await reviews; this is a stage-history/integration wording issue, not a story or illustration defect.
